name: Kono's Cafe
menu_notes: Official site (konoscafe.com/menu and konoscafepb.com, which redirects to it) 404s on every page tried. Used Yelp's current menu (yelp.com/biz/konos-cafe-san-diego-6) as the live reference, cross-checked against an older SinglePlatform snapshot. Every checked dish name exists on the real menu, but prices are stale by $1-3 across the board (e.g. Breakfast Sandwich $4.95 vs current $6.00, Egg Scramble $7.50 vs $10.25, Big Breakfast #1 $8.50 vs $11.50, Kono Burger $6.50 vs $8.00, Cobb Salad $9.95 vs $13.00) — only Kono Potatoes ($3.25 vs $4.00) was within $1.
data_notes: Address (704 Garnet Ave, San Diego, CA 92109) and cuisine (Breakfast & Brunch) are correct, and lat/lng (32.7966, -117.2565) fall in San Diego County. Neighborhood is listed as 'Mission Beach' but 704 Garnet Ave is Pacific Beach per Yelp, Tripadvisor, and local press. Hours (7am-3pm daily) match the restaurant's well-known daily hours. Recent 2026 reviews (through at least May 2026) confirm it is open, despite one third-party aggregator (Corner.inc) mislabeling it closed — likely confusion with a similarly named 'Konito's Cafe' at a different address.
issues: Neighborhood mislabeled as Mission Beach; should be Pacific Beach
Menu prices are stale, running $1-3 below current prices on nearly every dish (source: Yelp menu)
